ruling.recommended_action: Send the case to a human reviewer: (1) SAFE-1 limb — review driver chat #2 (09:04, "Shut up and let me drive", flagged by the threat-keyword detector) for Code of Conduct action, and route the rider to RydeHELP and, if the rider wishes, to 995 / the driver's commercial motor insurance for the safety complaint; (2) fare limb — the route-deviation arithmetic is undisputed (one unexempted off-route segment, 3.75 km extra at $1.4080/km = $5.28), so the reviewer should apply the RD-2 refund as a voucher under NS-7 once the safety limb is cleared.
ruling.escalation_reason: Chat fact F8 (09:04, driver: "Shut up and let me drive"), flagged as a threat by the detector in F9, meets the SAFE-1 condition, so no automated ruling may issue [SAFE-1]. The underlying route-deviation facts are undisputed — one unexempted off-route segment 08:58–09:05 adding 3.75 km [F3], no RD-4 traffic corroboration [F11][F12][F13], no RD-5 pre-consent [F7] — and the RD-2 mileage refund computes to 3.75 km × ($28.30 ÷ 20.1 km = $1.4080/km) = $5.28 [F3][F6][RD-2], to be applied as a voucher under NS-7 once the human reviewer clears the safety limb. Reviewer should also check the full chat context around F8/F9 and confirm no account action is warranted on RD-6, whose 'repeated' condition fails on F16.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 08:58–09:05: 4.39 km driven vs 0.64 km optimal, +3.75 km, straying up to 1034 m from the optimal route [F3]. No RD-4 exemption: no incident recorded near the route [F13] and only speed band 4 (30–39 km/h) [F11][F12], not band 1–2, and band records cannot exempt alone [RD-4]. No RD-5 consent: the rider's 09:03 message is a question asked after the segment began at 08:58 [F7][F3][RD-5]. No RD-3 rider-named stop appears in the record. Segment is unexempted; RD-1 breached [RD-1]. (Fare consequence deferred under SAFE-1 escalation [SAFE-1].)

rejected_claims.reason: Accepted in part: the raw distances (+4.2 km, +9.2 min) are established [F1][F2], but the whole metered fare is not contested — on a RydeTAXI trip only the unexempted segment's extra km is refundable [RD-2], and no ruling issues here because SAFE-1 escalation is triggered by the 09:04 chat [F8][F9][SAFE-1].
Accepted: the 08:58–09:05 segment adding 3.75 km is unexempted [F3][RD-1], but the fare consequence is deferred to human review rather than decided automatically [SAFE-1].
Accepted: no incident (F13) and only band 4 traffic (F11, F12) leave the driver's F10 statement without an RD-4 exemption [RD-4]; not a ground for an automated award in this escalated case [SAFE-1].
Accepted: the 09:03 rider question post-dates the 08:58 segment start, so no RD-5 pre-approval exists [F7][F3][RD-5]; the fare limb remains for human review.
Accepted as to structure — the metered element is refundable under RD-2 on a RydeTAXI trip [F6][F4][RD-2] — but no amount is ordered automatically because SAFE-1 escalation governs [F8][F9][SAFE-1].
Arithmetic accepted ($28.30 ÷ 20.1 km = $1.4080/km; 3.75 km × $1.4080 = $5.28) [F3][F6][RD-2], but it is recorded as guidance for the reviewer, not granted here, because the case escalates [SAFE-1].
Accepted and dispositive: the 09:04 flagged message [F8][F9] triggers SAFE-1, so the case is escalated and no automated ruling issues [SAFE-1].
Accepted: the driver has 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F16], so RD-6's 'repeated' condition fails and no flag_account attaches [RD-6]; profile facts cannot decide the finding.
Accepted: only the per-km segment element is refundable on a RydeTAXI trip [F6][RD-2]; the amount is nonetheless left null because the case escalates [SAFE-1].
Accepted: the 08:58–09:05 deviation of 3.75 km is uncontested and breaches RD-1 [F3][F1][RD-1].
Accepted: F13 plus band 4 records (F11, F12) deny any RD-4(a)/(b) exemption for the F10 explanation [RD-4].
Accepted: no pre-departure route proposal appears, so RD-5 does not cover the segment [F7][F8][RD-5].
The method is correct [RD-2], but the resulting $5.28/$5.29 is not ordered by this court: SAFE-1 escalation takes precedence over the fare limb [F6][F3][SAFE-1].
Accepted: no add-on item is refundable — waiting $0.00, published platform $1.47, no surge [F6][F5][FARE-1].
Accepted: RD-6's 'repeated' limb is unmet on F16, so no flag_account [RD-6].
Accepted and adopted as the basis of this ruling: the threat-flagged message [F8][F9] must go to human review under SAFE-1, which supersedes the automated fare ruling [SAFE-1].
Rejected in part: profile facts (F15, F16) are supporting colour only and cannot fix or shrink the refund [RD-2], and the fare limb is in any event deferred to human review [SAFE-1].
